[Image: Geometric construction with intersecting arcs]

In the figure above, an arc of a circle with center P has been drawn to cut the line at Q. Then an arc with the same radius and center Q was drawn to cut the first arc at R. What would be the size of angle PRQ?
figure_description: A horizontal straight line has two marked points, P to the left and Q to the right. An arc of a circle centered at point P begins at point Q on the line and curves up and to the left. A second, shorter arc centered at point Q intersects the first arc at a marked point labeled R, which lies above the line segment PQ.
